_README: This ONE file makes the app yours. Fill in your details, keep the quote marks and commas exactly as they are, save, then run: node scripts/customize.js  (Claude can do this for you). Never put passwords or Stripe keys in this file.

organization._help: name: your Chabad in English. nameHe: the same in Hebrew. region: the area you serve, used in sentences like 'across Springfield'. towns: the towns you serve, used in 'across Springfield and Shelbyville'. city/state: where the building is. slug: a short lowercase word used in file names and the app's saved data.
organization.name: Chabad of Sampleton

contact._help: These appear in the app, on receipts pages and in the privacy policy. ein is your US tax ID (for example 12-3456789); it is shown so donors can claim their tax deduction.

website._help: url: your main website, with https:// and without a slash at the end.

location._help: timezone: for example America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles. candleZip: the US zip code used for candle lighting times (outside the US ask Claude to adapt this).

payments._help: Card payments are set up with Stripe in SETUP-GUIDE.md. zelle: the email or phone that receives Zelle (leave empty to show 'ask us'). venmo: your Venmo username without the @.

android._help: Only needed if you publish the app in Google Play. A reverse web address, for example org.springfieldchabad.pushka. It can never change once published.

links._help: Optional pages on your website. Leave empty to link to your website's home page.

features._help: buildingCampaign: shows a building campaign section with giving levels (only if you have one; its wording is in pushka/pushka.js and pushka/i18n.js). kiddushBoard: shows 'Sponsor a Kiddush' in Give (needs the separate Kiddush board set up, see store/kiddush-setup.md).
